summary: Frontend refinement pass verification of Dashboard bento redesign. Logged in via mock auth (empty fields) → dashboard-page renders. Verified all rv-* testids, hero 3-stat strip (Prior YTD / Avg / month / Best month) updates per segment, KPI cards + colored sparklines (6 bars each, teal/navy/amber), segments show ring %, share pill and 'pts vs pace' text, top accounts 1..5, account search/expand/empty, CSV export, chart tooltip, range toggles, and chart↔segments card height parity (637 vs 637 = 0px diff). No console errors. Tested at 1920x1080 and 1280x900. One visual defect: at 1920 the segment pills wrap onto a separate row BELOW the figure instead of sitting top-right on the same row.

ui_bugs.issue: At 1920, segment pills (rv-seg-all/us/dist) wrap to a second row (y=240) below the figure (y=155) rather than being top-right on the same row as the $11,572,416 figure. Root cause: .rv-hero-top uses justify-content: space-between with flex-wrap: wrap. The 60px-font figure + delta pill consumes enough width that the pill group is pushed onto its own line because the eyebrow+figure sub-block is a single flex child taking full available width until it overflows and wraps the sibling. Fix: place .rv-eyebrow at top and move the pill segmented control up next to the eyebrow (top row) — OR put the .rv-seg absolutely on top-right of the hero card — OR restructure hero-top so eyebrow row and figure row are separate, with .rv-seg positioned in the eyebrow row (top-right).

action_items: Fix hero segment pills at 1920: they should sit top-right on the same row as (or above) the figure, currently wrapping to a second line. Suggested: restructure .rv-hero-top so .rv-eyebrow and .rv-seg share the top row (space-between), then the figure sits below on its own line — matches spec 'segment pills top-right'.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero-stats 'Prior YTD' is computed as h.invoiced / (1 + h.delta/100) but h.delta values are stored as negative percentages (e.g., -14.7); the formula would divide by (1 - 0.147) which correctly implies prior=invoiced/(1+delta/100) when delta = (cur-prior)/prior. For 'all' delta=-14.7 → prior≈$13.57M matches display ($13.6M). Verified numerically consistent.
Recharts occasionally logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings during initial mount (harmless).
